name: review-run-metadataroot-smoke-prompthash-red-on-main
title: review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root-smoke fails on main with the same legacy promptHash mismatch as evidence-state-gate-smoke
description: node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root-smoke.js (not registered in proof-or-stop.config.json validate.commands nor in the root test:serial-reference chain) fails on the unmodified main dist at 28e6372a03 in Proof B (rr-mr-e2e-1) with invalid Prompt Envelope: legacy ReviewRun promptHash does not match the frozen legacy role body. Reproduced byte-identically on main by the B-83aa CHK-003 implementer on 2026-09-03 while fixing the wrapper-root legacy-run cwd routing (commit 3c1f50e10a on story/B-83aa), so it is unrelated to that change. This is the same failure class as draft evidence-state-gate-smoke-prompthash-red-on-main and should be fixed together: re-derive the legacy promptHash from the current frozen role body (or decide the legacy v1 path is retired), then register both smokes so they cannot rot silently.
